About Me

I am passionate about the intersection of business and technology, particularly how digital solutions and data can support more effective business processes and decision-making.

My academic and project experiences have allowed me to work with data analysis, artificial intelligence, automation, business analysis, digital banking, and product development. I also have experience leading project teams, coordinating tasks, monitoring project progress, and translating ideas into structured deliverables.

I am particularly interested in opportunities related to Digital Banking, Data Analytics, Business Technology, and Digital Transformation.

AI Adoption &
Employee Productivity
Research Project | SmartPLS

This research examined the relationship between Employee AI Adoption and Employee Productivity, with Employee Engagement as a mediating variable and Organizational Support as a moderating variable.

My Contributions
  • Developed the research framework and hypotheses
  • Contributed to research methodology and data analysis
  • Conducted analysis using SmartPLS
  • Evaluated the structural model and R² values
  • Interpreted relationships between research variables
  • Contributed to the discussion and interpretation of findings
